sub: Snap or upload any object, give it a name, and hit Forge. Under the hood that's Asset upload, then Lux3D — concept image, image-to-3D, humanoid auto-rig, and ten retargeted moves — plus a RenderCloud KO poster. Sharing the original photo is off by default, and it needs a consent attestation.
